text: Girl, what are you wearing in the rain? It's my full body umbrella. Look, it goes almost all the way to the ground, so it covers way more than a regular umbrella. Okay, that really covers your whole outfit. Exactly, and I can still see everything through it. Wait, is that zipper part of it? Yeah, it's always right here on the side. You unzip it, step in, and zip it back up. Okay, that's actually smart. And my coat stays dry the whole time. Links below if you want to check it out.
